subject: copIterator: return context error to avoid return incorrect result on context cancel/timeout (#53489)
summary: Updates `pkg/store/copr` `copIterator.Next` to return `ctx.Err()` (wrapped) instead of `(nil, nil)` when the iterator exits due to context cancel/timeout, preventing DistSQL from misinterpreting cancellation as normal EOF and silently producing partial/incorrect results; adds a failpoint-driven regression test in `pkg/executor`.
